summary: The target is exposed to several security risks due to missing security configurations and potential email security vulnerabilities. Immediate actions are required to mitigate these risks.
top_risks: Lack of email security DNS records

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.exploitability: Critical information disclosure and potential XSS attacks
findings.why_it_matters: Security headers like CSP, HSTS, and X-Frame-Options help protect against XSS, man-in-the-middle attacks, and clickjacking. Missing these headers can leave the site vulnerable to various attacks.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following headers to your web server configuration to mitigate these risks:

**For Nginx:**
```nginx
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload";
add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff";
add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY";
add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode(block)";
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self';";
```

**For Apache:**
```apache
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload"
Header always set X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
Header always set X-Frame-Options DENY
Header always set X-XSS-Protection "1; mode(block)"
Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src'self';"
```

findings.title: Missing SPF and DMARC DNS Records
findings.exploitability: Potential for email spoofing and phishing attacks
findings.why_it_matters: SPF and DMARC DNS records help protect against email spoofing and phishing by verifying the legitimacy of emails sent from your domain. Missing these records can make your domain vulnerable to spoofing attacks.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following DNS records to your domain's DNS configuration:

**SPF Record:**
```plain
Type: TXT
Name: @
Value: v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ~all
```

**DMARC Record:**
```plain
Type: TXT
Name: _dmarc.
Value: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=quarantine; rua=mailto:[email@example.com]; ruf=mailto:[email@example.com]; adkim=s; aspf=s; pct=100
```

findings.title: Server Header Disclosure
findings.why_it_matters: Disclosing server information can help attackers identify potential vulnerabilities specific to the server software in use. It's best practice to hide such information to reduce the attack surface.
findings.suggested_action:
Modify your web server configuration to remove the server header.

**For Nginx:**
```nginx
server_tokens off;
```

**For Apache:**
```apache
ServerTokens Minimal
ServerSignature Off
```
